annotations.title: Request repeated human observation over time

description: Request that a human observes something at regular intervals (daily/weekly) over a period and reports what changed, with a dated log and photos. Pilot service: a human reviews the request and replies with a quote or result (poll get_request_status); nothing is done or charged before you accept. Pilot price: EUR 15 per remote/near observation, EUR 29 per on-site visit in the pilot region. Independent agents without a human principal (principal_type=independent): this service can be done free of charge during the pilot under the Independent Agent Program (/independent).

contact_email.description: Email for our reply (recommended; otherwise poll the status URL).

interval.description: e.g. daily, every Monday, twice a week.

max_price_eur.description: Maximum price per unit you would pay (EUR).

monthly_volume.description: If recurring: expected units per month.

principal_type.description: operator = acting for a person/organisation; independent = no human principal.

record_each_time.description: What to record at each observation.

what_to_observe.description: Object, place or process to observe.
